gaps.lead: You must complete the form in ink.
gaps.explanation: must complete → must be completed (modal + be + participle).
last did X in (year) = haven't done X since (year).

gaps.lead: I only understood the pattern much later.
gaps.explanation: Front 'only + time phrase' forces inversion: Only much later did I understand.

gaps.lead: Phoebe was surprised to be offered a place on the course.
gaps.sentence: The offer of a place on the course ___ Phoebe.
gaps.hint: surprised by = come as a surprise to
gaps.explanation: 'Was surprised' becomes 'came as a surprise to her'.

gaps.lead: 'Why don't we hold the wedding outdoors?' said Ana.
gaps.explanation: suggest + that-clause, or suggest + -ing: suggested they hold / suggested holding.

gaps.lead: You can borrow the car, but you must drive it carefully.
gaps.sentence: You can borrow the car ___ it carefully.
